svg.title: One world, three declared sensor models
svg.desc: One CPU owner advances the world at 120 ticks per second. The camera renders splats and meshes into 320 by 240 RGBA frames when its period divides the tick. The microphone models rotor harmonics at 2n/60 hertz, delay max(d, d0)/c and seeded noise, giving 133, 133 and 134 samples in three ticks. The heat camera models motor heat with backward Euler and reports radiance, not a temperature image.
